findings.claim: The addon refactor of apply_filter_normalisation and the KINDS change reach the Ask scope model (addons/intelligence/app/schemas.py AskScope), which is not in the touch-point list.
findings.impact: Ask scopes now accept kinds ['epub'] (previously 422), and every Ask-scope 422 detail text now carries a field-label prefix ('tags: ...', 'kinds: unknown kind: ...'). The spec's section 7 mentions the epub effect, but the planned touch points name only SearchFilter, KINDS and the /files/matching body.
findings.evidence: addons/intelligence/app/schemas.py:826 calls apply_filter_normalisation(self); addons/intelligence/app/file_matching.py:107 KINDS gains 'epub'; file_matching.py:130,148,167,170,189 error messages gain the '{label}:' prefix used by both models.
findings.repro: POST an Ask request with scope {kinds:['epub']}: before the change 422, after it accepted. A scope with kinds:['movie'] now answers detail 'kinds: unknown kind: movie'.

bucket_proposal.reason: Breaks no declared invariant (I19 covers epub for the filter; spec section 7 accepts the Ask effect) but the reached module is absent from the touch-point list.

findings.proposed_fix: Add addons/intelligence/app/schemas.py (AskScope) to the addon touch points, or note that the shared helper reaches it.

findings.claim: The SearchFilter type change (favorite/liked from boolean to boolean|null, six new keys) reaches frontend/src/lib/semanticSearch.ts and frontend/src/lib/semanticSearchRequest.ts, which are not in the touch-point list.
findings.impact: Every consumer of SearchFilter now serialises favorite:false when the query holds -is:favorite; consumers not listed were not reviewed for the new shape. No user-visible defect found.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/lib/semanticSearch.ts:10,62 and semanticSearchRequest.ts:4,12,21 import SearchFilter; searchQuery.ts SearchFilter now has favorite: boolean | null; tests searchScopeOperators.test.ts and semanticSearch.passages.test.ts had their expected favorite:false changed to null.

bucket_proposal.reason: A reach outside the declared list; behavior appears correct.

findings.claim: The change edits fixtures and expectations in other specs' existing tests (SPEC-CORE-117/099 member-target tests, SPEC-CORE-043 and SPEC-CORE-040 filter tests, SPEC-CORE-043/047/138 menu-order tests), and the frontend test directories are not in the touch-point list.
findings.impact: ReadingApp.memberTarget.test.tsx and VideoApp.memberTarget.test.tsx changed 'sf-neg' from '-tag:read'/'-tag:draft' to 'unread -tag:read'/'drafts -tag:draft', so the case once labelled 'a negated token, free text to the parser' now carries free text; the no-free-text negated member path is instead covered only by the new appTargetNegation.test.tsx. A reader of the old spec tests may not notice that their meaning changed.

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariant broken; the edits follow the revised invariants, but they lie outside the listed touch points.

findings.claim: The listed touch point frontend/src/app/app-api/smart-collection-members/route.ts is not changed, so its evaluation of a Smart Collection with only new tokens (e.g. '-path:Work') passes no memberLimit and reads every listing page even when meta.total exceeds 10,000.
findings.impact: If Notes and Clips evaluate members through this route (the knowledge addon is not in this checkout), a '-path:Work' Smart Collection on a large drive pages through the whole drive before the app falls back, contrary to the early stop that I17 states for 'the evaluation'. The result is the same; only time and load differ.
findings.evidence: route.ts:80-91 calls evaluateSmartCollection without memberLimit; smartCollectionEval.ts:142-148 stops early only when input.memberLimit is set; inNameResolution.ts:172 and memberTarget.ts:111 pass it.

bucket_proposal.reason: I17's last clause says the evaluation with no free text reads no page after the first one whose total exceeds 10,000; this evaluation path does not stop.

findings.proposed_fix: Either pass memberLimit in route.ts when the caller needs only usability, or confirm that Notes/Clips do not use this route and drop it from the touch points.

specification_compliance: Backend: FileFiltersQuery, filtered_drive_files, apply_file_filters, the listing/folder-counts/tag-counts/shelves callers and FileMatchingRequest all carry the six new keys; ShelfQuery, TagCountsQuery and FileListingQuery subclass FileFiltersQuery (shelves.py:367, drives.py:1148,1154), as I2 requires.
Frontend parsing, chips, chip removal, suggestions, impossible check and the refused in: state follow the spec's sending steps 1-9 as read.

Touch points listed but not reached by the diff: frontend/src/lib/api.ts, readingAppTarget.ts (reached through resolveAppTarget/resolveMemberTarget), smart-collection-members/route.ts (see R4), GlobalSearch.tsx and FolderBrowser.tsx (reached through hooks).

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: useFolderFiles now skips the in: resolution (loads no collection lists) when the query has an impossible kind or range even if it holds no new token, which changes SPEC-CORE-116 loading for pre-existing in: queries.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: A query such as 'in:Trip type:video' on an image-fixed page now loads no list; the user sees the same empty result with fewer requests.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: The memberLimit early stop applies to the in: resolution of any Smart Collection without free text, including ones whose query holds no new token, so those also stop after the first page over 10,000.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: An in: naming a large operator-only Smart Collection reports too large after one page instead of after reading all pages; the visible outcome is the same.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: The search window's launcher turns off Go-to rows, folder jumps and tag suggestions (and stops loading the drive's tag names) while the typed query is impossible.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Typing 'tag:x -tag:x' in the window hides every jump and suggestion row; the spec only says an impossible query requests nothing.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: Excluding a collection that exists in another drive only, or a name that no collection carries, is sent and excludes nothing, while an in: of the same name would list nothing.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: A typo in '-in:Tirp' silently excludes nothing and the results look unfiltered; the spec allows it but does not say the user gets any hint.

regression_risks: SearchFilter.favorite/liked changed type to boolean|null; any future producer writing favorite:false for 'unset' would now send favorite:false to the addon.
